services.name: Day Camp
services.desc: Returning this summer, our Pre-K 4 group offers a welcoming introduction to camp for children preparing to enter kindergarten. Designed with younger campers in mind, this program focuses on building confidence, independence, and social-emotional skills through play-based, hands-on activities. Campers in grades K-6 will enjoy full days of engaging activities designed to keep them active, curious, and connected. Programming is thoughtfully planned to support growing independence, build confidence, and encourage positive peer interactions throughout the day.
